name: Executioner
overview: The Scriptures reveal the role of the executioner as a figure of authority and judgment, often serving under kings or rulers as the chief officer responsible for carrying out capital punishment and enforcing royal commands. Passages such as Genesis 37:36 and Jeremiah 39:9 describe executioners as chief marshals or captains of the guard, highlighting their position within the governing structure. Proverbs 16:14 underscores the executioner's role as an instrument of a king’s wrath, while Daniel 2:14 and Matthew 14:10 demonstrate their involvement in both protecting the wise and executing justice, including the beheading of John the Baptist. Together, these verses show the executioner as a necessary, though sobering, agent in the administration of divine and earthly justice.
